_comment: Memory-anchor CURRENCY ATTESTATIONS (sc-22667, epic sc-22657). An anchor's currency key is normally derived at its own measurement revision (scripts/anchor-loader-closure.mjs --stamp-anchors), so a pin bump that touches the model's loader closure stales it. This repository's invalidation doctrine is two-gated: a differing closure digest is not evidence that memory behaviour changed - only a load-or-device-path change without a behaviour witness is. An entry here records, per anchor, that the closure diff from `measuredRevision` to `attestedRevision` was read file by file and is accounting-only (contract pricing, byte walkers, facts, tests, docs) or is witnessed unchanged by a re-measure on the same hardware; `--stamp-anchors` then derives that anchor's key at `attestedRevision` and copies the attestation into the store's `source.currencyAttestation`. The attestation is BOUNDED: it names one revision, `measuredRevision` must still equal the cited record's inference revision, and a later pin bump that moves the loader closure past `attestedRevision` stales the anchor again until it is re-read (a new entry) or re-captured (delete the entry). Never write one for a load-or-device-path change without a measured witness - that is the false green the currency key exists to prevent. Reviewed narrative: docs/calibration/sc-22657/anchor-currency-attestation-sc-22667.md (c6d6a4db, sc-22667; extended to 8a65db2a by the sc-22723 feature pin, and to 563c44e1, 3b922bac and e16c6a55 by the sc-22738 terminal pins).

attestations.why: 3cd86ba2..c6d6a4db DOES touch the Krea loader path (candle-gen-krea loader.rs / pipeline.rs / transformer/mod.rs / control*.rs, candle-gen quant/mod.rs + quant/adapt.rs, candle-gen-boogu, candle-gen-qwen-image and candle-gen-pid files the closure reaches), so the diff alone cannot classify this anchor. It is attested on a MEASURED witness instead: the E6 falsification fixture re-measured krea_2_turbo q4 at a5f643ae (22 first-parent merges after 3cd86ba2) on the same GPU and the cold staged control reproduces the packaged anchor per phase. The remaining a5f643ae..c6d6a4db range is accounting-only: gen-core lib.rs (re-export), memory_strategy.rs (contract types), weightsmeta.rs (walker hidden-cache skip) and candle-gen quant/sidecar.rs (CACHE_DIR constant re-homed, same value). Extended to 8a65db2a (sc-22723 feature pin, inference PRs #946-#958): c6d6a4db..8a65db2a touches four files of this closure and none is a load or device path - gen-core encoder_contract.rs (packed-marker struct kept whole, a stale-marker allowance only mlx-gen-flux2 calls, the hf_cache_discovery_roots authorization helper, tests), gen-core lib.rs (its re-export), gen-core wan_i2v_memory.rs (Wan-only identity tokens) and candle-gen-krea lib.rs (the per-(route, proven tier) identity table and weights-free surfaces; the q4 turbo identity this anchor is keyed to is unchanged, and the new provable-tier read consults the marker the loader already validated). loader.rs, pipeline.rs, transformer/, control*.rs, candle-gen quant/ and every device path are untouched. Extended to 563c44e1 (sc-22738, the epic final pin = inference main, merge of feature PR #960 over main 1cd0e393): 8a65db2a..563c44e1 changes nine inference files and exactly two are in this closure, gen-core encoder_contract.rs and lib.rs. Both are a REMOVAL, not a change of behaviour: inference PR #961 (sync of main into the feature branch) drops the sc-22727 stale-packed-marker tolerance that sc-22760 made unnecessary - the two entry points `source_for_load_with_stale_packed_marker` / `validate_source_for_discovery_with_stale_packed_marker`, the `RequiredWithStalePackedMarker` policy arm and its `stale_packed_marker()` reader, the `declared_quant` rewrite in `validate_source_with_policy` that was the identity for every other policy, `PackedQuantization` back to crate-private, and the allowance test; lib.rs drops the matching re-export. The only production caller of the removed surface was mlx-gen-flux2 (the FLUX.2 Klein turnkey inventory), which this closure does not reach; `source_for_load`, `validate_source_for_discovery`, `requires_config` for `Required` and every shard/header/quantization-evidence check this model executes are byte-for-byte the same code path before and after. The remaining seven files (mlx-gen-flux2 artifact_inventory.rs / loader.rs / memory_strategy.rs / model.rs, its two test files, release/real-weight-models.toml) are outside this closure. No load or device path this anchor reaches changed. Extended to 3b922bac (sc-22738, inference main = the merge of PR #962 over 563c44e1, its first parent): 563c44e1..3b922bac changes fourteen inference files, all under crates/media/mlx-gen/mlx-gen-krea and crates/media/mlx-gen/mlx-gen-krea-realtime (the harness-authorized calibration_fault hooks at every phase exit of the MLX krea base and realtime generators, their memory_strategy.rs helpers and tests), and the intersection with this closure's closureFiles is EMPTY - this is the CANDLE krea closure (candle-gen-krea and candle-gen), which never links mlx-gen-krea or mlx-gen-krea-realtime. The closure digest is byte-identical across the range (config/anchor-loader-closures.json records the same digest for this model at 563c44e1 and 3b922bac; only krea_2_raw:mlx and krea_2_turbo:mlx moved), so this is the trivial extension the bump script's remediation names: nothing this anchor loads or executes changed, and no file is added to filesChangedSinceMeasurement. Extended to e16c6a55 (sc-22738 fourth terminal pin, 2026-09-07; inference main = the merge of PR #965 fix/sc-22738-wan-rehost-tolerance over #964 fix/sc-22738-wan-t2v-memory-contract over #963 fix/sc-22738-mlx-progress-boundaries over 3b922bac): 3b922bac..e16c6a55 changes eleven inference files (gen-core residency.rs and wan_i2v_memory.rs; mlx-gen-bernini bernini.rs and its conformance test; mlx-gen-mage model.rs and pipeline.rs; mlx-gen-wan config.rs, i2v_memory_strategy.rs, memory_strategy.rs and model.rs; one mlx-gen-flux real-weight test) and the intersection with this closure's closureFiles is exactly ONE file, crates/contracts/gen-core/src/residency.rs. That diff is instrumentation-only (+195/-8, of which 147 lines are new unit tests): ensure_warm_locked drops its on_progress parameter and no longer emits Loading(TextEncoder)/Loading(Renderer) itself; the two warm (!stage_residency) arms of run_request_scoped and run_staged_request_scoped emit Loading(TextEncoder) before the warm load and Loading(Renderer) AFTER the prompt encode, both gated on the new warm_needs_load; the staged arms, run_two_phase, the components loaded, their order, their devices and the offload policy are byte-identical. This anchor was measured on the STAGED arm (measuredRegime.staged = true: the 3cd86ba2 capture drove candle-gen-krea's run_request_scoped with stage_residency), which the diff does not touch, so neither what it loads nor where the phase boundaries it was cut on fall changed. No file is added to filesChangedSinceMeasurement.
attestations.witness: docs/calibration/sc-22657/candle-five-rung-falsification-sc-22667.json krea_2_turbo q4 coldStagedControl at a5f643ae against the packaged anchor: conditioning 3.694 GB vs 3.828 (-3.5%, under), denoise 15.099 vs 15.103 (-0.02%), decode 22.349 vs 22.352 (-0.01%). The batch's resident rung (12.73 GB conditioning) also brackets the contract's 11.73 GB component total, as the E6 test asserts. No re-measure for c6d6a4db..8a65db2a: that segment carries no load or device path change (files listed), so the classification stands on the diff, as the doctrine allows.

attestations.why: Every file the z_image_turbo:candle loader closure changed in 670dc1f4..c6d6a4db carries contract ACCOUNTING, not load or device behaviour: candle-gen-z-image/src/memory_strategy.rs grew the per-component asset facts, architecture facts and loaded-path pricing the sc-22657 law reads; candle-gen/src/architecture_facts.rs is a new snapshot-config reader for those facts; gen-core's memory_strategy.rs / weightsmeta.rs / wan_i2v_memory.rs carry the contract types and the tensor-free byte walkers (materialized_* readers; the .candle-device-format-v1 hidden-cache skip) that price the checkpoint without touching the loader; gen-core lib.rs and candle-gen lib.rs are re-export / `pub mod` lines for those; gen-core registry.rs and runtime.rs move a #[cfg(test)] helper and fix a Windows-only test fixture; candle-gen-pid/src/engine.rs names the f32 load dtype and merged-file constants it already used (same values, and PiD is not on the Z-Image path); candle-gen/src/quant/sidecar.rs re-homes the `.candle-device-format-v1` CACHE_DIR literal to gen-core's constant with the same value. No loader, pipeline, weights, kernel, quant or device-format code path changed. Extended to 8a65db2a (sc-22723 feature pin, inference PRs #946-#958): c6d6a4db..8a65db2a touches four files of this closure and none is a load or device path - gen-core encoder_contract.rs (packed-marker struct kept whole with same-value accessors, a stale-marker allowance only mlx-gen-flux2 calls, the hf_cache_discovery_roots authorization helper, tests), gen-core lib.rs (its re-export), gen-core wan_i2v_memory.rs (Wan-only identity tokens) and candle-gen-z-image memory_strategy.rs, whose selected_encoder_discovery_roots now authorizes the HF-cache repository dir as a symlink target for the text-encoder planning-facts readers - a validation gate, not a load: the same bytes reach the same device the same way. pipeline.rs, model.rs, the loader and every device-format path are untouched. Extended to 563c44e1 (sc-22738, the epic final pin = inference main, merge of feature PR #960 over main 1cd0e393): 8a65db2a..563c44e1 changes nine inference files and exactly two are in this closure, gen-core encoder_contract.rs and lib.rs. Both are a REMOVAL, not a change of behaviour: inference PR #961 (sync of main into the feature branch) drops the sc-22727 stale-packed-marker tolerance that sc-22760 made unnecessary - the two entry points `source_for_load_with_stale_packed_marker` / `validate_source_for_discovery_with_stale_packed_marker`, the `RequiredWithStalePackedMarker` policy arm and its `stale_packed_marker()` reader, the `declared_quant` rewrite in `validate_source_with_policy` that was the identity for every other policy, `PackedQuantization` back to crate-private, and the allowance test; lib.rs drops the matching re-export. The only production caller of the removed surface was mlx-gen-flux2 (the FLUX.2 Klein turnkey inventory), which this closure does not reach; `source_for_load`, `validate_source_for_discovery`, `requires_config` for `Required` and every shard/header/quantization-evidence check this model executes are byte-for-byte the same code path before and after. The remaining seven files (mlx-gen-flux2 artifact_inventory.rs / loader.rs / memory_strategy.rs / model.rs, its two test files, release/real-weight-models.toml) are outside this closure. No load or device path this anchor reaches changed.
